title: Skam's "Old but Gold" is a timeless rock soundtrack that hits right in the soul
htmlContent:
Skam's latest single, "Old but Gold," showcases the timeless power of energetic music and sincere songwriting. "Old but Gold" grabs your attention with exciting guitar riffs, strong drumming, and a bassline that has an effortless groove.

Lead singer Steve Hill delivers a passionate performance, blending a rough edge with a melody that makes every word impactful. The band is fully invested in this song, making it as good as it sounds. "Old but Gold" is about being strong in the face of challenges, embracing your true self, and proving that age or time can't reduce something special. This song is for anyone who has ever felt underestimated or overlooked.

https://open.spotify.com/track/7oF2FeyRSTqBSTjDYiK0eD?si=DwyP67iNRv2nt2b1KEqDRA

The highlight of this song is its ability to evoke deep emotions. It captures raw feelings that resonate and stick with you. Skam not only pays homage to the classic rock era but also reminds us that the spirit of great music is very much alive.
